title: Unary certificate length computation
statement: For all $C,c\\in\\mathbb{N}$, the function on bit strings sending $x$ to the word consisting of $C(|x|+1)^c$ copies of $1$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: For all $C, c \in \mathbb{N}$, the function sending a bit string $x$ to the word $1^{C(|x|+1)^c}$ consisting of $C(|x|+1)^c$ ones is polynomial-time computable.
